description: This file defines the DatabaseConnectionWrapper class, which manages database connection instances, error handling, and connection establishment logic within the installer utility of the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connection instances and handling related errors during system installation processes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with a database connection instance and an optional error Throwable.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Returns true if an error has occurred, based on the presence of an exception.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a user-friendly message describing the error that occurred during database connection or operation.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the stored Throwable instance representing the error, if any.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: A static method that attempts to establish a database connection using a provided callback, with checks for required PHP extensions and error handling.
